subject: Gentree Workspace kickoff & admin seeding plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@gentree.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@gentree.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Gentree Workspace kickoff & admin seeding plan

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. This thread is to lock the initial workspace provisioning plan so we can seed admin access, create the first project, and hand off API key seeding to your engineering lead. Attached is a short kickoff agenda and a proposed role matrix.

High-level plan (today -> next 7 days):
- Today: confirm admin list and decide whether you want SSO now or later.
- Day 1 (provisioning): Redwood creates workspace "gentree-prod" and seeds a single project "gentree-mvp".
- Day 2: we generate a short-lived bootstrap API key and an initial service key for CI (you rotate after validation).
- Day 3: invite users with mapped roles (Admin / Developer / Read-only).
- Day 7: verify eval prompts and routing with your eng team, finalize production keys.

Ask to Gentree: please confirm the primary admin (email) and whether you require SCIM/SSO during initial seeding. If you prefer we wait on SSO, we will proceed with email invites and manual role assignment.

Attachments: gentree-kickoff-agenda.pdf, redwood-role-matrix.csv, gentree-mvp-prompts.xlsx

Proposed meeting: 30 min tomorrow (Tue 09:30 PT) for live provisioning (I can run the console steps). Let me know if that works.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
H: +1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Mercer <alex@gentree.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@gentree.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gentree Workspace kickoff & admin seeding plan

Thanks Hannah — this looks great. Quick answers:
- Primary admin: priya.s@gentree.com (Priya Singh, IT Manager).
- SSO: we plan to enable SSO next sprint (not required for the initial seed).
- CI/service key: yes, we'll need a service key for the ingest pipeline; rotation policy is 90 days.

One ask: can the initial bootstrap API key be flagged as "expires after 72h" so our engineers use it for validation only? Also want to confirm the project name is gentree-mvp (no spaces).

If the 09:30 PT meeting works, Priya and our eng lead Samir will join.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform, Gentree Health
Attachment: gentree-org-chart.pdf (org chart)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@gentree.com>, Priya Singh <priya.s@gentree.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gentree Workspace kickoff & admin seeding plan

Hi Alex / Priya —

I can take care of the bootstrap key and the service key. Plan I will execute during the live session:
1) Create workspace: gentree-prod (console path: Admin -> Workspaces -> Create).
2) Create project: gentree-mvp (Admin -> Workspaces -> gentree-prod -> Projects -> Create).
3) Seed temporary API key: key id seed-gentree-20260719 (expires in 72 hours).
4) Create service key: key id svc-gentree-ingest (scopes: embeddings:write, completions:read). Recommend you store this in your vault and rotate after 90 days.
5) Invite users: Priya (Admin), Samir (Developer), Alex (Read-only exec).

Security notes:
- Keys created via console are shown once — copy into your vault before closing the modal.
- If you want HSM/KMS integration for keys later, we can schedule the Private deployment on your timeline.

I'll also add a short post-provisioning checklist to the drive link.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Gentree Workspace kickoff & admin seeding plan

Following up with the role mapping and invite cadence — please see the attached role matrix. I'll perform the invites during the session but will stagger invites to ensure the bootstrap key is validated first.

Role mapping (short):
- Admin (Priya): workspace + project admin, billing visibility.
- Developer (Samir): project-level full access (create models, keys scoped to project).
- Read-only Exec (Alex): reports and logs, no key access.

Invite cadence:
- T+0: Priya only (Admin) — confirm invite and accept.
- T+1: Samir (Dev) — validate service key and integration.
- T+2: Alex (Exec) — confirm dashboards and observability access.

Attachment: redwood-role-matrix.csv (roles and granular permissions)

I'll be on the call at 09:30 PT to run the invites. If Priya needs SCIM mapping later we can replace manual invites with SCIM connector mapping.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — meeting went well and we validated the bootstrap key and service key. Quick notes from Gentree side:
- Verified seed-gentree-20260719 (it indeed expired after 72h when we tested rotation).
- svc-gentree-ingest scoped correctly; our eng lead Samir will push to vault this afternoon.
- We confirmed project name gentree-mvp and workspace gentree-prod.
- Next step: we want a short doc with recommended token costs per prompt from the MVP prompts attachment — can someone from Redwood create a short guide?

Appreciate the help, looking forward to the production rollout next month.

—Priya
